hook: IMAX returns to Hyderabad after *10 years* on Dec 18
hook_b: IMAX returns to Hyderabad after *10 years* on Dec 18
tldr: AMB Victory Cinemas at RTC Cross Roads opens an IMAX with Laser screen on December 18 with Dune: Part Three. Prasads stopped original-format IMAX in 2015 after the switch to digital. A second IMAX is planned at AMB Cinemas, Hakimpet.

beats.what: Asian Cinemas, under a deal with IMAX Corporation, launches the format at AMB Victory Cinemas: one IMAX laser screen, a 4DX screen and five regular screens.
beats.why: Prasads Multiplex dropped original IMAX screenings in 2015 when films moved from reels to digital.
beats.care: Showtimes and seats are not yet listed; the theatre is on IMAX's official site.

twist: It stands on the site of Sudarshan Theatre, opened in 1970 and demolished in 2010.
